description: This file contains unit tests for the PrivilegeValidator class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for Privilege objects.

classes.name: PrivilegeValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PrivilegeValidator validation logic in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPrivilegeIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the privilege name is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when the description is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when privilege and description have valid values.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when privilege and description fields are within length limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when privilege and description fields exceed length limits.
